title: CIS OFDM HDR Modem
short: Russian OFDM HDR (High Data Rate) Modem. Has three main modes: CIS-45, CIS-60, and CIS-93, corresponding to the number of OFDM tones in the signal.
desc: **Russian OFDM HDR (High Data Rate) Modem**. Has three main modes: **CIS-45**, **CIS-60**, and **CIS-93**, corresponding to the number of OFDM tones in the signal. For all three modes, there is a carrier located 3300 Hz from the suppressed carrier. In addition, all three modes utilize PSK OFDM Modulation.
